why:
All three layers survive the challenge. (1) QUOTE VERBATIM: curl -sL https://code.claude.com/docs/en/whats-new/2026-w13.md, line 154 of 164, inside the 'Other wins' grid: '
Agents can declare initialPrompt in frontmatter to auto-submit a first turn
'. The whole line is that single div — there is no second sentence and nothing reverses the claim. The page is row 175 of scripts/claude-doc-pages.tsv, so it is a Claude Code contract source, not a Codex or platform page. (2) OUR STATE: `grep -rani initialprompt packages apps scripts` (broad, -a, no --include filter so NUL-byte files are not skipped) returns 0 hits. packages/shared/src/agents/definitions.ts carries memory, background, color, isolation, mcpServers and skills (normalizers and reject-on-malformed at :413-457, ARRAY_FRONTMATTER_KEYS at :279) and has no initialPrompt member anywhere. The only repo hits are prose: the plan, the parity audit, the r-queue verification and the sweep JSONs. The cited docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-29-subagent-frontmatter.md:150 says exactly what was claimed — the Outcome table row '| `initialPrompt` | `documented, not implemented — no main-session-agent surface (`--agent` flag or `agent` setting) exists to run an agent definition as the main session` | — |'. (3) CONSEQUENCE VERIFIED SEPARATELY FROM THE IDENTIFIER, and it holds. sub-agents.md:292 makes the main-session surface the field's own precondition: 'Auto-submitted as the first user turn when this agent runs as the main session agent (via `--agent` or the `agent` setting).' That surface is absent here: the apps/cli flag set is {--api-key,--base-url,--disable-spinner,--help,--json,--json-schema,--mode,--model,--name,--no-cleanup,--no-spinner,--output-format,--provider,--safe-mode,--send-timeout,--server-entry,--source,--stdin,--strict,--timeout,--tls-ca,--token,--url,--validate-server,--verbose,--version,--workspace,--workspace-dir} — no --agent and no --agents (sub-agents.md:222); no `agent` settings key in packages/shared/src/config; and defaultAgent/mainAgent/primaryAgent/rootAgent/topLevelAgent match nothing outside node_modules @types/node. So parsing the field would produce an inert value by the doc's own rule ('Ignored when the agent is invoked as a subagent'). SIBLING-SUBSYSTEM TRAP CHECKED AND NOT TRIGGERED: SessionManager.ts:11024-11124 does read `input.agent`, but that is the subagent admission path ('Start agent ${selectedAgentName}'), i.e. Agent/Task dispatch — a different subsystem, and the finding correctly names the main-session surface rather than that one. UPSTREAM-ALREADY-HANDLED trap checked: nothing upstream supplies or consumes the field; there is no handler to make the consequence false. NOT AN OWNER DECISION: the nine dated entries in docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-29-inert-worklist.md §3 are SEATBELT_TESTING_WILDCARD, availableModels/enforceAvailableModels, autoMode.classifyAllShell, ManagedDeliveryStateV1.drops, plugins/hooks-runtime.ts, SdkMcpServerConfig.required, SessionMirrorStore.delete, MirrorSessionKey.subpath/listSubkeys, and listSessionSummaries/listSessions — initialPrompt is not among them. NOT A DELIBERATE PRODUCT DIFFERENCE: it is unrelated to the dropped Claude/ChatGPT subscription flows, the corporate gateway, or the NESSY_ rebrand. It IS a recorded, categorised deviation — harvested into docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-29-deviation-register.md:309 as '**not implemented** — no main-session-agent surface (' — but under this repo's deviation rule a recorded 'documented, not implemented' is still a divergence with a written reason, not a non-divergence, and the finding says so itself rather than overclaiming. The finding is accurate in every particular and is confirmed.
correctedState: Confirmed as written, with the doc precondition made explicit. `initialPrompt` has zero hits across packages, apps and scripts (grep -rani, -a, no include filter → 0), and packages/shared/src/agents/definitions.ts has no such member while carrying memory/background/color/isolation/mcpServers/skills. The consequence is independently true: sub-agents.md:292 scopes the field to 'when this agent runs as the main session agent (via `--agent` or the `agent` setting)', and neither surface exists in this fork — no --agent or --agents flag in apps/cli, no `agent` settings key, no defaultAgent/mainAgent concept outside node_modules. SessionManager.ts:11024's `input.agent` is the subagent admission path, a sibling subsystem, not a main-session-agent surface. Recorded deviation: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-29-subagent-frontmatter.md:150, harvested to docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-29-deviation-register.md:309.
